newsitem.title: USA: Linens 'n things Q1 sales rose.
newsitem.headline: Linens 'n things Q1 sales rose.

text.p: Linens 'n Things said Wednesday comparable net store sales for its superstores increased 7.7 percent during the first quarter while comparable net stores sales for the whole company increased 5.7 percent.
It said its total sales for the first quarter ended March 29 rose 30.2 percent to $179.9 million from $138.2 million for the comparable quarter in 1996.
Linens 'n Things operates 165 stores, including 132 superstores, in 34 states across the U.S.
